The judgement is that the required cut is large enough to beat even that bar.

The street's Q4 of $88.6m against $1.9m in Q2 rests on energisation that the late-October capacity update shows reaching the hall at only 9 of 12 sites (i2), and the forward commentary is what the print turns on; the +32.4 vol-point put skew is the most extreme directional statement in the day's universe and nothing here explains why it is wrong, which caps the long case from the 59% drawdown and the $356m non-dilutive facility.

The real bar is core ex-Ximalaya growth and the arithmetic says the headline beat is almost entirely inorganic (i2) while QuestMobile shows traffic erosion at the light-user apps accelerating through the end of Q2 (i3); the name sold three of its last four prints by 9.6-25%. The CFO's 'preparing for another round of buyback' with RMB44bn of cash is the one sizeable positive.

Management quantified only mid-July to mid-August, and the gauge record shows the Rhine at record lows on 28 September with Kaub near zero into mid-October (i1), so both the back half of Q3 and the October peak of Q4 are hit beyond what was disclosed - with a +19.3 put skew agreeing. The reset level, the 2027 book at 53% sold, and three peer beat-and-raises keep it from being larger.

The expectations item is the whole case: the Q3 EPS bar was cut from $0.35 to $0.23 while the stock broke below even the Morgan Stanley and BofA bear targets (i1), a ~20%-of-float short at 15.8 days to cover sits against it (i2), and a ~6% RMB translation tailwind means the $415m revenue bar implies -11.5% constant currency, seven points worse than Q2 (i0). Sized small in points because this name's realised print moves are 1-3%.

A seasonal beat of the identical guide top is the base case and the street already sits above it, so the sign turns on the Q4 guide: a flat FY needs about $93m while Yalla's Q4 ranges run $78-85m, and this name punishes 'inside guide' prints (-6.7%, -8.3%) harder than it rewards beats (i2). The offset is a stock at roughly zero enterprise value buying back $18m a quarter against 339k ADS of daily volume.
